info.name: FreeSize
info.summary: Find what takes space in Nextcloud and clean it up, approved on your phone
info.description:
The FreeSize app pairs Nextcloud with a FreeSize Hub, like any other device. For the users the admin chooses, it tells the Hub what could be cleaned up, from the real files on the server: files nobody changed in a year, the biggest files, the same file twice (by a SHA-256 of its contents), and what the trash bin and old versions take.
Nothing is ever deleted by itself. A delete asked for on the Hub has to be approved on the approver's phone, and the files go into Nextcloud's trash bin, where their owner can restore them.
info.author: FreeSize
